Rajasthan.title: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund – Medical Help
Rajasthan.department: Medical Welfare Department, Government of Rajasthan
Rajasthan.overview:
Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund (CMRF) – Medical Help Scheme is a welfare initiative of the Government of Rajasthan designed to provide financial assistance to residents of the state who are suffering from serious, life-threatening and chronic diseases. Medical treatment for critical illnesses often involves high costs, which can become unaffordable for many families despite having a moderate income. This scheme aims to bridge that financial gap by offering monetary support for medical treatment in government as well as recognized private hospitals.

Under this scheme, eligible patients can receive financial assistance through Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) or Demand Draft, depending on the nature of treatment and approval. The assistance helps patients continue or complete their medical treatment without interruption due to lack of funds. The scheme is particularly helpful for individuals suffering from diseases such as cancer, kidney failure, heart ailments, major surgeries, and rare disorders like Thalassemia Major.

The Chief Minister's Relief Fund Medical Help Scheme reflects the Rajasthan government's commitment to ensuring that no citizen is deprived of essential healthcare due to financial constraints. By providing timely assistance, the scheme plays a crucial role in saving lives and improving the overall healthcare accessibility in the state.
objectives: To provide immediate financial assistance to Rajasthan residents suffering from serious and life-threatening diseases
To reduce the financial burden of expensive medical treatments on families
To support patients undergoing long-term and critical medical procedures
To ensure access to quality medical treatment in government and recognized private hospitals
To strengthen the state’s social security and healthcare support system
benefits: Financial assistance provided through Direct Bank Transfer or Demand Draft
Support for treatment of critical diseases such as cancer, kidney disorders, heart diseases and serious surgeries
Special assistance for Thalassemia Major patients up to ₹50.7 lakh as per medical requirement
Cochlear Implant Surgery assistance for deaf and mute children up to 6 years of age (subject to income criteria)
Medical treatment support in government hospitals and approved private hospitals
Timely help during medical emergencies to avoid treatment delays
Rajasthan.detailed_benefits:
The Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund – Medical Help Scheme provides customized financial assistance based on the nature of disease, estimated treatment cost, and medical recommendations. Unlike fixed-amount schemes, the relief amount under CMRF varies from case to case. This flexible approach ensures that patients receive adequate financial help according to their medical needs.

For patients suffering from chronic and long-term illnesses such as cancer, kidney failure requiring dialysis or transplant, and serious heart conditions, the scheme covers a significant portion of treatment expenses. In the case of Thalassemia Major, which requires lifelong medical care, the scheme provides assistance up to ₹50.7 lakh, making it one of the most impactful medical support initiatives in the state.

Additionally, the scheme supports Cochlear Implant Surgery for deaf and mute children below 6 years of age, helping them gain access to advanced medical procedures that can significantly improve their quality of life. The assistance is directly transferred to beneficiaries or hospitals to maintain transparency and accountability.

By offering financial assistance during medical emergencies, the scheme has helped patients continue life-saving treatments without financial distress. It has also strengthened public trust in the state’s healthcare and welfare system by ensuring transparency and timely support. Rajasthan.title: Chief Minister Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana
Rajasthan.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Rajasthan
Rajasthan.overview:
Chief Minister Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana is a flagship social security scheme of the Government of Rajasthan aimed at providing monthly financial assistance to widowed, divorced and abandoned women (Ekal Nari) belonging to economically weaker sections of society. Women who lose spousal or family support often face serious financial and social challenges, especially in rural and semi-urban areas. This scheme is designed to ensure dignity, financial independence and basic livelihood support for such women.

Under this pension scheme, eligible women receive a fixed monthly pension directly in their bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The pension amount increases with age, ensuring better financial security as beneficiaries grow older. The scheme not only provides economic relief but also strengthens women empowerment and social inclusion in Rajasthan.

By offering continuous financial support, the Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana helps beneficiaries meet daily expenses such as food, medicines and basic household needs, reducing their dependency on others.
objectives: To provide monthly financial assistance to widowed, divorced and abandoned women
To ensure basic livelihood and dignity for economically weak women
To promote social security and women empowerment in Rajasthan
To reduce poverty and financial dependency among single women
To provide age-based increasing pension benefits
benefits: ₹500 per month for women aged 18 to 55 years
₹750 per month for women aged 55 to 60 years
₹1000 per month for women aged 60 to 75 years
₹1500 per month for women above 75 years
Monthly pension credited directly to bank account via DBT
Regular financial support for daily living expenses
Rajasthan.detailed_benefits:
The pension amount under the Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana is structured according to age groups to ensure increased support as beneficiaries grow older. Younger beneficiaries receive a basic pension amount, while senior women receive higher assistance considering their increased healthcare and living costs.

The pension is transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account, ensuring transparency and eliminating middlemen. This continuous financial support helps beneficiaries manage essential expenses such as food, healthcare, rent and utilities. The scheme plays a vital role in preventing extreme poverty among single women and provides a safety net against financial insecurity.

Rajasthan.title: Rajasthan Scheme for Study Abroad (Meritorious Girl Students)
Rajasthan.department: Higher Education & Social Welfare Department, Government of Rajasthan
Rajasthan.overview:
Rajasthan Scheme for Study Abroad for Meritorious Girl Students is a prestigious educational empowerment initiative of the Rajasthan Government. The scheme aims to provide international higher education opportunities to exceptionally talented girl students studying in government schools. By offering full financial and logistical support, the scheme enables selected students to pursue graduate-level education abroad for four years.

The primary objective of this scheme is to promote gender equality in higher education and empower girls from Rajasthan with global exposure. Selected students receive comprehensive support including tuition-related expenses, accommodation, airfare and academic preparation costs. The scheme ensures that financial limitations do not restrict meritorious girls from achieving global academic excellence.
objectives: To promote international education opportunities for meritorious girl students
To empower girls through global academic exposure
To encourage excellence among students studying in government schools
To support gender equality in higher education
To develop future global leaders from Rajasthan

Up to ₹50,000 for SAT registration fee
₹25,000 for foreign university application process
Accommodation facility provided by foreign university
Economy class airfare for student and one parental visit per year
Up to ₹10 lakh per year expenditure covered for 4 years
Rajasthan.detailed_benefits:
The scheme covers nearly all major expenses associated with international education. Financial support includes coaching and registration for SAT examinations, university application assistance, travel costs and annual academic expenses. The state government ensures accommodation support through foreign universities, significantly reducing financial stress on families.

Additionally, selected students receive structured academic preparation and mentoring support, ensuring their smooth transition to international education systems. This holistic approach enables beneficiaries to focus on academics and personal development without financial concerns.

Uttar Pradesh.title: Samaj Kalyan Vibhag Scholarship – Uttar Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh.overview:
Samaj Kalyan Vibhag Scholarship is one of the most important and wide-coverage scholarship schemes implemented by the Social Welfare Department of Uttar Pradesh. The scheme is designed to provide financial assistance to students belonging to economically weaker and socially disadvantaged sections of society so that lack of money does not become a barrier in their education.

Under this scholarship program, students from Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Classes (OBC), Minority communities and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) receive financial support for their education from school level to postgraduate and professional courses. The scholarship helps cover expenses related to tuition fees, maintenance allowance, books and other educational needs.

The scheme plays a crucial role in reducing dropout rates, encouraging higher education and promoting social equality by ensuring that students from underprivileged backgrounds can continue their studies with dignity and confidence.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to economically weaker students of Uttar Pradesh
To promote access to education for SC, ST, OBC, Minority and EWS students
To reduce school and college dropout rates
To encourage students to pursue higher and professional education
To promote social inclusion and educational equality

Maintenance allowance to support daily educational expenses
Fee reimbursement for eligible courses
Direct transfer of scholarship amount to bank account
Support for education from school level to postgraduate courses
Uttar Pradesh.detailed_benefits:
The Samaj Kalyan Vibhag Scholarship provides financial assistance in multiple categories depending on the student’s level of education. Pre-matric students receive support to continue schooling without financial stress, while post-matric and higher education students receive higher scholarship amounts to cover tuition fees, examination fees and maintenance expenses.

The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student’s bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), ensuring transparency and timely payment. This financial support helps students purchase books, pay fees and manage living expenses, thereby reducing the economic burden on families.

By supporting education across various levels, the scheme helps build a skilled and educated workforce in Uttar Pradesh and contributes to long-term socio-economic development.

Uttar Pradesh.title: Uttar Pradesh Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme (Divyangjan)
Uttar Pradesh.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh.overview:
The Uttar Pradesh Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme for Divyangjan is a welfare-oriented initiative of the Social Welfare Department aimed at promoting social inclusion, dignity and equality for persons with disabilities. In many cases, differently-abled individuals face social stigma, financial challenges and limited support during major life events such as marriage. Recognizing these challenges, the Government of Uttar Pradesh introduced this scheme to provide one-time financial assistance at the time of marriage.

The scheme is not merely a financial aid program but a social empowerment measure that encourages acceptance and integration of Divyangjan citizens into mainstream society. By offering monetary support, the government helps reduce the economic burden associated with marriage-related expenses, thereby enabling differently-abled individuals to begin married life with confidence and dignity.

The incentive amount is credited directly to the beneficiary’s bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), ensuring transparency, accountability and timely assistance. Only legally registered marriages are eligible, and strict verification mechanisms are followed to ensure benefits reach genuine beneficiaries.
objectives: To promote social inclusion and dignity of persons with disabilities
To encourage marriage among eligible Divyangjan citizens
To reduce financial stress related to marriage expenses
To ensure equal participation of differently-abled individuals in society
To strengthen the state’s disability welfare support system
benefits: ₹15,000 incentive if the groom is differently-abled
₹20,000 incentive if the bride is differently-abled
₹35,000 incentive if both bride and groom are differently-abled
One-time financial assistance
Direct Benefit Transfer to beneficiary’s bank account
Uttar Pradesh.detailed_benefits:
The Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme provides graded financial assistance depending on the disability status of the bride and groom. When only the groom is a person with disability, an incentive of ₹15,000 is provided. If the bride is differently-abled, the incentive increases to ₹20,000, acknowledging the additional social and economic challenges faced by women with disabilities. In cases where both partners are Divyangjan, a higher incentive of ₹35,000 is granted.

This financial support can be used for marriage-related expenses such as household setup, essential goods or initial financial stability. The amount is transferred directly to the bank account to prevent misuse and ensure transparency. The scheme emphasizes dignity and empowerment rather than charity, reinforcing the idea of equal rights and opportunities.

Neither spouse should be an income tax payer
Neither spouse should have any criminal conviction

Uttar Pradesh.title: Uttar Pradesh Pre Examination Training Centers Scheme
Uttar Pradesh.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh.overview:
The Uttar Pradesh Pre Examination Training Centers Scheme is a major educational empowerment initiative aimed at providing free and quality coaching to students from Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Other Backward Classes (OBC). Competitive examinations such as UPSC, UPPSC and other government recruitment exams often require expensive coaching, which many economically disadvantaged students cannot afford.

To bridge this gap, the Government of Uttar Pradesh established Pre Examination Training Centers across the state. These centers offer structured classroom coaching, expert faculty guidance, study materials, mock tests and interview preparation at no cost to selected candidates. The scheme ensures that talented students are not deprived of opportunities due to financial constraints.

By promoting equal access to competitive exam preparation, the scheme supports social justice, educational equality and inclusive representation in government services.

Mock tests and interview preparation
Study materials and structured syllabus coverage
Special facilities for women candidates at select centers
Uttar Pradesh.detailed_benefits:
The scheme offers comprehensive preparation support covering preliminary, mains and interview stages of competitive examinations. Classroom sessions focus on conceptual clarity, answer-writing skills and exam strategy. Mock tests and practice sessions help candidates evaluate performance and improve time management.

Selected training centers also provide counseling, motivational sessions and academic mentoring. Women candidates receive additional support through reserved seats and dedicated facilities at selected centers. By eliminating financial barriers, the scheme enables students to compete on merit and confidence.

Madhya Pradesh.overview: मध्य प्रदेश श्रम विभाग द्वारा संचालित सुपर 5000 (कक्षा 10वीं) योजना के अंतर्गत वैध पंजीकृत निर्माण श्रमिक के पुत्र एवं पुत्री को शैक्षणिक प्रोत्साहन दिया जाता है। इस योजना का उद्देश्य निर्माण श्रमिकों के बच्चों को उच्च शिक्षा के लिए प्रेरित करना है।
benefits: ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त प्रोत्साहन राशि
राशि जीवनकाल में केवल एक बार प्रदान की जाती है
प्रत्यक्ष लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में भुगतान
eligibility: आवेदक वैध परिचय-पत्रधारी पंजीकृत निर्माण श्रमिक का पुत्र या पुत्री होना चाहिए
मध्य प्रदेश माध्यमिक शिक्षा मंडल द्वारा आयोजित कक्षा 10वीं परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण हो
कक्षा 10वीं की संपूर्ण राज्य मेरिट सूची में प्रथम 5000 विद्यार्थियों में स्थान प्राप्त किया हो
शासकीय विद्यालय में अध्ययनरत अथवा स्वाध्यायी विद्यार्थी होना चाहिए
आवेदक की आयु 13 वर्ष या उससे अधिक हो
applicationProcess: योजना हेतु आवेदन संबंधित विद्यालय के प्राचार्य के माध्यम से किया जा सकता है
या फिर संभाग / जिला श्रम कार्यालय में आवेदन प्रस्तुत किया जा सकता है
आवेदन पत्र के साथ सभी आवश्यक दस्तावेज संलग्न करें
सत्यापन के बाद प्रकरण स्वीकृति हेतु सक्षम अधिकारी को भेजा जाता है

faqs.q: सुपर 5000 योजना क्या है?
faqs.a: यह योजना निर्माण श्रमिकों के बच्चों को कक्षा 10वीं में उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए प्रोत्साहन राशि प्रदान करती है।

faqs.q: योजना के अंतर्गत कितनी राशि दी जाती है?
faqs.a: ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाती है।

faqs.q: क्या यह लाभ एक से अधिक बार मिल सकता है?
faqs.a: नहीं, यह लाभ जीवनकाल में केवल एक बार दिया जाता है।

faqs.q: आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि क्या है?
faqs.a: परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने के अगले वर्ष की 31 मार्च तक आवेदन किया जा सकता है।

faqs.q: कहां आवेदन किया जा सकता है?
faqs.a: संबंधित विद्यालय के प्राचार्य या जिला/संभाग श्रम कार्यालय में।

sources: श्रम विभाग, मध्य प्रदेश – आधिकारिक दिशा-निर्देश

Madhya Pradesh.title: लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग – आगामी भर्ती कार्ययोजना
Madhya Pradesh.department: लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग, मध्य प्रदेश
Madhya Pradesh.overview: मध्य प्रदेश शासन द्वारा लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग में आगामी समय में लगभग 6,700 पदों पर भर्ती की कार्ययोजना तैयार की गई है। इस योजना का उद्देश्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं को सुदृढ़ करना तथा प्रदेश की जनता को गुणवत्तापूर्ण एवं समयबद्ध निःशुल्क स्वास्थ्य सुविधाएं उपलब्ध कराना है।

benefits: चिकित्सक, विशेषज्ञ एवं पैरामेडिकल स्टाफ को सरकारी भर्ती का अवसर
शिक्षित एवं तकनीकी वर्ग के लिए रोजगार सृजन

समय पर चिकित्सा उपचार एवं बेहतर स्वास्थ्य ढांचा

पदवार पात्रता एवं आवेदन प्रक्रिया की जानकारी अधिसूचना में दी जाएगी

faqs.q: इस भर्ती कार्ययोजना के अंतर्गत कितने पद भरे जाएंगे?
faqs.a: इस योजना के अंतर्गत कुल 6,700 पदों पर भर्ती प्रस्तावित है।

faqs.q: किन-किन श्रेणियों के पद शामिल हैं?
faqs.a: प्रथम, द्वितीय, तृतीय एवं चतुर्थ श्रेणी के पद शामिल हैं।

faqs.q: क्या यह स्थायी सरकारी भर्ती होगी?
faqs.a: भर्ती की प्रकृति एवं सेवा शर्तें आधिकारिक अधिसूचना में स्पष्ट की जाएंगी।

faqs.q: आवेदन कब से शुरू होंगे?
faqs.a: आवेदन तिथि शासन द्वारा अधिसूचना जारी होने के बाद घोषित की जाएगी।

Bihar.title: Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal)
Bihar.overview: Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal) का उद्देश्य राज्य के दिव्यांग नागरिकों को शारीरिक, सामाजिक, शैक्षणिक और आर्थिक रूप से सशक्त बनाना है। इस योजना के अंतर्गत दिव्यांगजन कल्याण से जुड़ी विभिन्न राज्य एवं राष्ट्रीय योजनाओं का लाभ त्वरित रूप से प्रदान किया जाता है।

faqs.a: यह बिहार सरकार की दिव्यांगजन सशक्तिकरण योजना है।

faqs.a: नहीं, यह योजना केवल बिहार के निवासियों के लिए है।
